body.title: Validate cumulative baseline intervals
body.summary: Extend reducer basis logic for qualified cumulative evidence: select one endpoint/baseline interval, allow explicitly reference-only prior-invocation baselines and prevent overlapping deltas from being added.
acceptanceChecks: Baseline, intermediate frames and reference-only records do not add consumption; two endpoints sharing a baseline are overlapping candidates, not two charges.
Same-session/model-slice monotone fixtures produce exact disjoint counter deltas only for the selected validated interval.
Missing/reset/different-session/model or unknown bucket baselines yield explicit unknown/partial outcomes; no timestamp winner or cross-session subtraction.
Cross-invocation baselines are accepted only under declared reference-only closure and qualified native session/model evidence.

tests.name: src/workflow/usage/__tests__/reducer.test.ts: cumulative selected interval, reference-only cross-invocation baseline, common-baseline overlap, resets and model/session mismatches
